+from rich.live import Live
+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.text import Text
+
+class EmptyRenderable:
+    def __rich_console__(self, console, options):
+        yield from []
+
+def test_empty_renderable():
+    console = Console(force_terminal=True)
+    try:
+        with Live(EmptyRenderable(), console=console) as live:
+            print("Started")
+            live.update(Text("Hello"))
+            print("Updated")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Caught: {e}")
+        raise e
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_empty_renderable()

+from rich.live import Live
+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.text import Text
+import time
+
+def test_empty_live_clear():
+    console = Console(force_terminal=True)
+    # Use a small width to make it obvious
+    console.width = 20
+    
+    with Live(Text("Line 1"), console=console) as live:
+        time.sleep(0.1)
+        live.update("") # Update to empty string
+        time.sleep(0.1)
+        # Now we print something else to see if the previous "Line 1" was cleared
+        console.print("Something else")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_empty_live_clear()
